description.text: This program(5 weeks ,summer program) is designed for students who wish to take advantage of their summer vacation to learn not just the Chinese language ,but also various aspests of Chinese cultuer. This program combines three hours of daliy Chinese language instruction along with special activities and cultures.The Chinese language courses has 2 levels ranging from beginner to intermediate .Cultural activities and field trips offer students hands-on experiences with traditional crafts,music ,martial arts.In addition ,special lectures that explore Chinese history ,religion and life help students widen and deepen their knowledge of Chinese culture.

duration.text: The Summer Chinese Language and Cultural at Zhejiang Wanli University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 833 USD/per semester ￥ 6000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized

requirements.text: The applicants need to have a formal education background at the high school level or above, a good moral character, be aged 18-55 and in good health.
